import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int next, to, cap;
        long cost;
        Edge(int next, int to, int cap, long cost) {
            this.next = next;
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static final int MAXN = 100010;
    static final int MAXM = 2000020;
    static final long INF = 1000000000;

    static Edge[] edges = new Edge[MAXM];
    static int[] head = new int[MAXN];
    static int edge_cnt = 1;
    static int total_nodes;
    static List<Integer>[] adj = new List[MAXN];

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int cap, long cost) {
        edges[++edge_cnt] = new Edge(head[u], v, cap, cost);
        head[u] = edge_cnt;
        edges[++edge_cnt] = new Edge(head[v], u, 0, -cost);
        head[v] = edge_cnt;
    }

    static class MCMF {
        static int[] cur = new int[MAXN];
        static boolean[] visited = new boolean[MAXN];
        static long[] dist = new long[MAXN];
        static long[] potential = new long[MAXN];
        
        static class Node implements Comparable<Node> {
            int node_id;
            long priority;
            Node(int id, long p) {
                node_id = id;
                priority = p;
            }
            public int compareTo(Node other) {
                return Long.compare(this.priority, other.priority);
            }
        }
        
        static PriorityQueue<Node> pq = new PriorityQueue<>();
        
        static boolean dijkstra(int source, int sink) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= total_nodes; ++i) {
                dist[i] = INF;
                cur[i] = head[i];
            }
            dist[sink] = 0;
            pq.add(new Node(sink, 0));
            
            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                int u = pq.poll().node_id;
                if (visited[u]) continue;
                visited[u] = true;
                
                for (int i = head[u]; i != 0; i = edges[i].next) {
                    int v = edges[i].to;
                    long w = potential[u] + edges[i ^ 1].cost - potential[v];
                    if (edges[i ^ 1].cap != 0 && dist[u] + w < dist[v]) {
                        dist[v] = dist[u] + w;
                        pq.add(new Node(v, dist[v]));
                    }
                }
            }
            
            for (int i = 1; i <= total_nodes; ++i) {
                potential[i] = Math.min(potential[i] + dist[i], INF);
            }
            
            if (!visited[source]) return false;
            for (int i = 1; i <= total_nodes; ++i) visited[i] = false;
            return true;
        }
        
        static int dfs(int u, int sink, int flow) {
            if (u == sink || flow == 0) return flow;
            int pushed = 0;
            visited[u] = true;
            
            for (int i = cur[u]; i != 0; i = edges[i].next) {
                cur[u] = i;
                if (edges[i].cap != 0) {
                    int v = edges[i].to;
                    int f;
                    if (!visited[v] && potential[v] + edges[i].cost == potential[u] && 
                        (f = dfs(v, sink, Math.min(flow, edges[i].cap))) > 0) {
                        edges[i].cap -= f;
                        edges[i ^ 1].cap += f;
                        pushed += f;
                        flow -= f;
                        if (flow == 0) break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            visited[u] = false;
            return pushed;
        }
        
        static int max_flow = 0;
        static long min_cost = 0;
        
        static void solve(int source, int sink) {
            while (dijkstra(source, sink)) {
                int flow = dfs(source, sink, (int)INF);
                max_flow += flow;
                min_cost += (long)flow * potential[source];
            }
        }
    }

    static int source_node = 1, sink_node = 2, n, m, k, c, d;

    static int get_id(int t, int x) {
        return t * n + x + 2;
    }

    static void build_layer(int t) {
        total_nodes += n;
        
        for (int u = 1; u <= n; ++u) {
            for (int v : adj[u]) {
                for (int p = 1; p <= k; ++p) {
                    add_edge(get_id(t, u), get_id(t + 1, v), 1, d * (2L * p - 1));
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int u = 1; u <= n; ++u) {
            add_edge(get_id(t, u), get_id(t + 1, u), Integer.MAX_VALUE, 0);
        }
        
        add_edge(get_id(t + 1, 1), sink_node, Integer.MAX_VALUE, c * (t + 1));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        c = sc.nextInt();
        d = sc.nextInt();
        total_nodes = n + 2;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; ++i) {
            int a = sc.nextInt();
            add_edge(source_node, get_id(0, a), 1, 0);
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            int u = sc.nextInt();
            int v = sc.nextInt();
            adj[u].add(v);
            adj[v].add(u);
        }
        
        add_edge(get_id(0, 1), sink_node, Integer.MAX_VALUE, 0);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + k; ++i) {
            build_layer(i);
        }
        
        MCMF.solve(source_node, sink_node);
        System.out.println(MCMF.min_cost);
    }
}
